short: The work: the commission and the boards
is: The workflow nouns: the commission aggregate (envelope, flat composition, facts, changelog, files, markup, seats, slots) and an account's boards with their fractional Position keys.
conventions: Each file owns its id type, value objects, and pure invariant logic.
The serde-deriving ids here are `CommissionId` (`Serialize` and `Deserialize`), and `ElementId` and `FileKey` (`Deserialize` only).

Ids derive `FromStr` forwarding to the inner type's error (`uuid::Error` for Uuid-backed ids, `DidParseError` for Did-backed ids); `From`/`Into`/`AsRef`/`Display` likewise forward, with no `Deref` and no `new` wrapper. Every error type is a `thiserror` derive.

Enum vocabularies derive strum (Display, EnumString, IntoStaticStr, VariantArray; serialize_all = snake_case), keep their typed Unknown* parse errors through parse_err_ty/parse_err_fn, and pin their literal token list in the sibling tests.rs; no hand-written ALL consts or as_str tables.

fs.name: commission/
fs.role: the aggregate: id (CommissionId, minted UUIDv7), entity (the stored envelope), rows (the create shapes and the listing read), element (flat composition), fact, changelog, commission_role, role_marker (AsParticipant, AsOwner: the write capability's role markers, uninhabited), deadline, direction, file, grant_level, lifecycle, markup, seat, seat_invitation, slot, standing, state (CommissionState, the stored facts a rule reads, and LateFacts), title (CommissionTitle over kernel's NodeName); the rules: lifecycle (move_lifecycle → LifecycleMove), direction (set_direction/clear_direction → DirectionSet/DirectionCleared → DirectionChange), deadline (schedule_deadline/clear_deadline → DeadlineSet/DeadlineCleared → DeadlineChange; set_delayed/clear_delayed → DelayedSet/DelayedCleared → DelayedChange; owes_late → LateMark), errors (CommissionRefusal); test_commission (cfg(test): a stored Commission for the rule tests)

fs.name: workflow.rs
fs.role: an account's boards — Workflow, Column, card placement, and the base-62 fractional Position key

fs.name: workflow/
fs.role: split of workflow.rs; no information beyond its façade

notes: `commission/` layout: `entity.rs` = the envelope (id, owner, lifecycle, deadline, maturity, the two status axes, linked channel, archive); `element.rs` = the flat composition (tabs/surfaces/elements, `SKELETON`, `effective_visibility`); `fact.rs` = the hard-delete gate contract; `changelog.rs` = the sealed changelog: `NewChangelogEntry`'s fields are private (read through accessors); each gated kind is built only by its own constructor from the change its rule passed (`created`, `renamed`, `lifecycle_moved`, `direction_set`/`direction_cleared`, `deadline_set` (set or extended)/`deadline_cleared`, `delayed_set`/`delayed_cleared`, `late` with no actor), keeping the stored payload shapes; `event` takes only an `OpenKind` (the kinds still recorded outside the gate) and answers an `OpenChangelogEntry`, the only shape with `with_note`; the standalone `note` stays; `deadline.rs`, `direction.rs` and `lifecycle.rs` = each vocabulary with its rules: a rule is a pure function over a `CommissionState` (and the act's time where Late matters) answering `Ok(None)` for a no-op, `Ok(Some(change))` for a real change, or a `CommissionRefusal`; a change's fields are private and only its rule builds it, a clear carries no new value, and each change gives the store's write its one value type by `From`; while Disputed the lifecycle and the deadline refuse first, the Delayed flag stays free; `file.rs`; `markup.rs`; `id.rs` = `CommissionId` and its `mint` (UUIDv7); `title.rs` = `CommissionTitle`, a newtype over kernel's `NodeName` that derives its parse and bubbles `NodeNameError` (no title rule of its own); `rows.rs` = `NewCommission` (only what a create may choose: maturity and deadline), `CommissionBirth` (what the den's write gate supplies: node, owner, creation time) and `CommissionSummary` (the listing read; loads carry the title as `StoredText`); `grant_level.rs` (view grants only); `commission_role.rs` = `CommissionRole { Participant, Owner }`, ordered least authority first and pinned by a test over `VARIANTS` (not persisted, so no token table); `role_marker.rs` = `AsParticipant` and `AsOwner`, uninhabited type-level markers a write capability's role names (an Owner-only reserve write takes `AsOwner`, any Participant's `AsParticipant`); they name nothing of the ports, and which `CommissionRole` each needs is the gate's table, not theirs; `start.rs` = `CommissionStart`, a new commission's starting state (lifecycle step, direction status, Delayed flag, linked channel, archive time); its hand-written `Default` is the rule (Draft, no statuses, unlinked, live), pinned by a literal test, and each adapter's create stores it, destructured with no `..`, deciding none of it (pg refuses a start that sets a field its insert leaves NULL); `LifecycleStep` has no `Default` on purpose; `standing.rs` = `CommissionStanding`, what one standing read answers (role, level, archived; no title, no row), and `LockedStanding`, the locked read's answer: the standing beside the node the commission points at; `seat.rs` / `seat_invitation.rs` / `slot.rs` (element satellites).

Composition structure is CODE (`element::SKELETON`), modes are DATA. Effective visibility = `min(tab, surface, element)` under the commission's own `Level` (kernel's). An absent `commission_surface_mode` row means `Total`. (DD 45514754)

Surface names must be globally unique across tabs: `commission_surface_mode`'s PK is `(commission_id, surface)` with no tab column, so a duplicate name would make widening one tab's surface widen the other's. Pinned by a unit test in `element.rs`.

`CommissionComposition`, `ElementRow` and `ElementPayload` implement no `serde::Serialize` **by design** — content leaves only through a viewer projection that applied `effective_visibility` server-side. A compile-time probe test in `element.rs` pins the absence.
Slots and Seats share one identity with their carrying element (`ElementType::SLOT_TAG` / `SEAT_TAG`); the interpreted data lives in a satellite table keyed by the element id.
Placement is account-side and lives in `workflow.rs` (a card on a board), never in `commission/grant_level.rs`. View grants are issued per-**User**. (DD 29130754 as amended)
`workflow.rs` orders columns and cards by `Position`, a base-62 fractional key compared **bytewise** — a store must order it bytewise too (`text COLLATE "C"`).

Fact-bearing types must register their table in the pg adapter's `COMMISSION_FACT_TABLES` in the same change that introduces them, and mirror the check in the mem fake; non-fact commission-owned tables go in `COMMISSION_NON_FACT_TABLES`.

Persisted enums (`LifecycleStep`, `DirectionStatus`, `DeadlineStatus`, `ChangelogEntryKind`, `VisibilityMode`, `GrantLevel`) own their storage tokens: renaming one is a migration, and an unknown token is always an error, never a silent default. The commission's and a board's visibility is kernel's `Level`, whose tokens kernel owns.

`Late` is derived by whoever asks, at the time they ask (`Commission::deadline_status_at(now)`, `CommissionState::deadline_status_at(now)`), never persisted and never derived by an adapter; the stored field is `delayed_flag` and the `deadline_status` column only ever holds `Delayed`.
